title: Gremlow Infestation!/Quotes
summary:
"It's driving me crazy! Every shop is selling nothing but these cheap toy mice! Don't they have anywhere to eat?"
- Den Fears to Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill

"Guggenheim's a little old to be running round dodging traps." (Den Fears)<br/ >
"He's on the Huntik Council. I'm sure he knows what he's doing." (Lok Lambert)

"It's a scary thing when kids are led astray by powerful forces, like your brother was."
- Cherit to Den Fears

"Nostradamus - he never could just speak plainly."
- Guggenheim to Lok Lambert

"Looks like Eathon's clue is gonna pan out after all." (Dante Vale)
